summary: Implemented L-R1 (320px layout: header wraps, 44px header targets, keep-all Hangul under 400px), L-R2 (ko/en switch persisted in localStorage mol-lang, browser-language first visit), L-R3 (serif hero title only) and L-R4 as a partial: CSS 3D prism per room card driven by the harness clock, but the faster first load was not achieved and LCP is unmeasured. Public selfcheck: request.L-R1 10, request.L-R3 10, request.L-R2 4 (the public lang probe assumes a Korean start and runs in en-US). tests/lobby-r1.test.mjs passes 5/5.
